verdict.rationale: Cline supports automation triggers like cron-scheduled agent runs via its CLI/hub and can be invoked headlessly inside CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab) which react to pipeline events, plus live reaction to terminal output during autonomous execution. However there's no documented general-purpose 'rules engine' letting users define arbitrary custom event-condition-action rules beyond scheduling and pipeline hooks. Missing for 10: a documented user-configurable trigger/rule system (e.g. 'on file change' or 'on webhook' rules), and independent evidence confirming these automation triggers work reliably in practice.
